DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The dispatch places me in the shared root checkout on `main`, while §21e says a task spanning hours gets a task branch. Switching the ROOT checkout's branch is reserved to the operator (§21d, 'branch switch inside a single-owner worktree: agents. Root: reserved.') and would move the branch under every peer sharing the checkout.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Commit directly on `main` from the root checkout through scripts/legend_commit.sh, path-scoped and under the commit lock.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: §21e states in terms that the root checkout and `main` are writable by every actor, and that a change finished when it is written may be committed on `main` directly. Path-scoping means no peer's in-flight file can be swept up.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: A task branch would have isolated the work, at the cost of either switching the shared root's branch (reserved) or provisioning a worktree whose only purpose is a change that is green when it lands.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: § 9.5(b)'s stated false-positive baseline — '13 unchanged on PMID 20530675' — does not reproduce: that surface returns 0. Every primary record (wave-4 eval, capability_scout_log, scientist-c's task ledger, commit 492a532) attributes the 13 to 'the wave-1 paper', which is PMID 21731849.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Measure all three surfaces, report the misattribution plainly, and hold the wiring to the budget on the CORRECTED attribution: 14 on PMID 18460020, 13 on PMID 21731849, 0 on the PMID 20530675 supplement.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The retrospective is not a normative file, and the numbers it misattributes are still the right numbers — only the paper label was wrong. Re-deriving all three costs one command each and removes the ambiguity instead of inheriting it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Reporting '13 on PMID 20530675, unchanged' would have been a false sentence in exactly the class § 9.4 exists to prevent — a value asserted with the confidence of a measurement.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: `validate()` has callers outside this module (session_self_eval.py) and 94 existing regressions; § 9.4 requires a WARN channel it does not have.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: An optional `warnings: list[str] | None` sink parameter rather than widening the return tuple.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Every existing caller is byte-for-byte unaffected; a caller that wants warnings opts in. Reversible in one edit.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: A three-tuple would have made every existing call site a mandatory edit before a single warning could be emitted, and would have broken session_self_eval.py, which is not mine to edit.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: A workspace with no full_text_queue_current.md cannot resolve any queue address, and blocking there would refuse every manifest validated against a bare workspace.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Declare the gap in `incomplete`, naming each identifier that went unchecked, instead of either blocking or passing silently.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The reader is told what was NOT asked. 'This check had nothing to check' and 'this check approved it' stay distinguishable — the exact failure class § 3.1 of the retrospective records (a screen that returned CLEAN without screening anything).
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Blocking would have made the check unusable off the shared checkout; silence would have reproduced the fail-open the retrospective names as the worst class.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: `framework/scripts/screen_verdict.py` has not landed (git log over that path is empty at the time of this task's deliverable 4).
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default_taken: Recorded in the report; deliverable 4 handled per the dispatch's own instruction to implement the same contract inline rather than wait idle, and screen_verdict.py was NOT created by me.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The dispatch names this branch explicitly. Creating the peer's file would violate exclusive ownership.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Waiting would have been a class-3 stop under §21c.
